summary.materialFinding: Two currently available Spanish Playtech networks expose explicit time- or amount-guaranteed jackpot mechanics: Kingdoms Rise on Betfair Spain and Age of the Gods Norse Gods and Giants on JOKERBET Spain.
summary.whyNotYet: Exact live tier state from the Playtech ticker, exact deployed pool topology, funding/hazard and final winner-allocation semantics are not yet verified.

playtechTickerContract.specification: Playtech Progressive Jackpot Ticker Specifications v3.1 (June 2022)

amountAttributes.guaranteedHitTime: Unix timestamp; provided only when a guaranteed hit time exists
amountAttributes.guranteedHitAmount: Guaranteed hit amount; spelling preserved from Playtech XML specification
amountAttributes.step: Ticker statistical increase speed per second when supplied

topologyContract.localParameter: local=1 selects a local jackpot for game-based XML requests; local=0 selects global when applicable
topologyContract.defaultProgressiveBinding: Ticker specification states available jackpot games are bound to casinos at progressive-network level by default, but this does not prove a particular operator deployment is global.
topologyContract.kingdomsRiseProviderEvidence: Playtech annual reporting states the Capped and Daily configurations introduced with Kingdoms Rise can be networked or localised.

playtechTickerContract.updateCadence: near real time; specification describes five-minute refreshes

currentAvailability.catalogObservedFreshness: current public catalog observed during 2026-08-26 research

spanishOperatorMechanics.dailyStrike: Awarded every day at a specific time/date
spanishOperatorMechanics.powerStrike: Awarded by reaching a specified played/amount condition displayed by the game
spanishOperatorMechanics.epic: Progressive and can be won on any spin

providerPrimaryArchitecture.annualReportSource: Playtech Annual Report 2019 - Technology and innovation / Kingdoms Rise
providerPrimaryArchitecture.description: Kingdoms Rise provides configurable Daily, Capped and Progressive jackpots; Playtech states the Capped and Daily configurations can be networked or localised.

williamHillSpainComparator.publishedNetworkScope: William Hill Spain states its Kingdoms Rise jackpot is accumulated from bets across games and all online casinos offering that jackpot.

historicalThreeTierComparator.reportedTopology: secondary historical sources describe single-casino or casino-group localisation

publishedMechanics.daily: must be won before countdown ends
publishedMechanics.extra: must be won before reaching a limit amount
publishedMechanics.instant: won immediately if the maximum established amount is reached

Resolve Betfair's exact Kingdoms Rise pool topology from ticker metadata or operator/deployment evidence; do not import William Hill network scope.
If direct ticker access remains unavailable, obtain one no-bet in-game screenshot showing the individual timer/cap and current tier amounts from one Spanish operator.
Recover the exact deployed jackpot funding split and winner-allocation semantics before treating proximity to guaranteed amount/time as deterministic or +EV.
Prospectively verify at least one full amount/time cycle and reset before real-money promotion.
